task.title: P6-139: Dedupe set-picker codes so duplicate chips stop sharing identical data-testid
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, Catalog, search and paging). Original id: P6-139. Size: S. Specs: specs/catalog-search.md.

**`s:mh3,mh3` renders two chips with identical `data-testid`/`data-code`** (was `P6-036f`) — a Playwright strict-mode violation for any future test, and removing one leaves the row's ✓ showing while the badge drops 2→1. `shared/search.rs:173-182`'s `csv()` has no dedupe, unlike `color_letters()` immediately below it, and `toggle_code` (`rail.rs:860-869`) never dedupes either.
